Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Owen often share different ideas about the plant garden. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, grazing bans slow desertification on the plateau.
Owen plans to study music harder this term. Owen's dream job is to be a cook. Owen has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term. Blue hour suits lit shopfronts.
Little by little, things began to change. The experience taught Owen more than any book could. Owen thanked Tom for the honest advice. What's more, they live on the south coast.
